skins.name: Allmind As One
skins.description: A possibility derived from when Executor connected to the Law : connected consciousnesses tend towards unity, all to achieve one goal. Exsequi. Exsequi. Exsequi.
skins.image: /six-star-skins/Executor the Ex Foedere - Allmind As One.webp

skins.name: Il Segreto Della Notte
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Il Segreto Della Notte
skins.description: A form-fitting combination of tailored clothes and exquisite accessories, displaying one's status without drawing too much attention. Comes with a VIP Carnevale invitation and too many balloons.
skins.image: /six-star-skins/Texas the Omertosa - Il Segreto Della Notte.webp

skins.name: Travel Freely
skins.description: A red and white baseball jacket over a black hoodie, paired with drawstring pants and sports shoes. Comfy and casual, unrestrictive and lightweight, suited for day-to-day travel.

skins.name: The Dark Night Terminator
skins.code: Iteration Provident Series/The Dark Night Terminator
skins.description: Crownslayer's iteration from decision point S/5258902. Dark clothes for an assassin. She grips her blade, determined to bring an end to the darkest corners of the city with her own hands.

skins.name: Diversity Oneness
skins.description: A possibility derived from when Virtuosa connected to the Law: emotions link together the hearts of all. The performer who once plucked at their heartstrings is now no more than a voice in the chorus.

skins.name: Warm Velvet At the Corner
skins.code: Cambrian 1100 Winter New Arrivals/Warm Velvet Corner
skins.description: A warm coat, both thick and lightweight, winter boots for icy, snow-laden roads, and a white knit cap complete with a bright bow. Proof you don't have to sacrifice warmth for cuteness.
